g.text: Lost, and would change what the agent does next

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #262626

g.text: ...and can't be recovered from the repo or any file

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Losses that matter grow from 9% to 17% of items by the 2nd compaction,

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: then level off; most of the extra losses don't matter

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: 54 real SWE-chat sessions. Grey: Experiment 1's lost share. Red and blue: that share times the share Opus 5.5 judged consequential (and not

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: recoverable) on a seeded 30 lost items per compaction; a product of two estimates, not hand-checked. 95% intervals: session bootstrap.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Later losses are mostly task state and decisions, which Opus usually finds recoverable from the repo.
